names: Sodium citrates (i) Monosodium citrate (ii) Disodium citrate (iii) Sodium citrate (trisodium citrate)

more_info.overview: Sodium citrates is used as a sequestrant in food. Its technological role is to bind metal ions.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include edible caseinates, milk-based drinks and similar products intended for young children, unflavoured pasteurised and sterilised (including uht) milk, fats and oils essentially free from water  (excluding anhydrous milk fat). These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
